Specification: This module specifies a tiny state machine that maintains a single record variable S containing a sequence q and an index i. The system starts with an empty sequence and i = 1, repeatedly appends the current value of i to q while incrementing i, and stops once i becomes greater than 2. The specification includes a type invariant for the record structure and domains, an initial-state predicate, two next-state alternatives (Send and Done), and a combined next-state action, but it does not state temporal properties, fairness conditions, or proofs.
